name: voltox-ai-dev-mcp
description: Voltox AI Dev MCP server: docs, guardrails, code, review and ep2-grade self-assessments for Voltox on wallee

scripts.build:stdio: npm run content && esbuild src/stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/stdio.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --legal-comments=none
scripts.build:worker: npm run content && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.test: npm run content && esbuild test/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=.test-build --out-extension:.js=.test.js --log-level=warning && node --test .test-build/*.test.js
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy
